GTA 6: Silent Hill Hotel Secret (and Puzzle Solution)
It’s so easy in a game as broad and dense as GTA 6 to not inspect every structure you pass by. But if you happen to be in a particular intersection in the middle of Vice City, there’s a condemned building called the Marbelle Hotel you’ll definitely want to check out, for both the cool secrets, and the rewards. 

Huge props to @xGarbett on X for finding this hidden gem.

text:
GTA 6 Has 4 In-Game Video Games You Can Actually Play!
Did you know GTA 6 has four fully playable video games hidden within Leonida? From a zombie survival shooter to a mysterious indie horror puzzle game, Grand Theft Auto 6 lets you take a break from crime and chaos to enjoy some games within the game! Here's a look at all four playable video games in GTA 6 and where you can find them.

In this guide, we'll show you Street Trash Dezombifier 3, Tenebrae Lux, Time Jackers: Rewind, and Bang for Your Buck. Three of these games can be played using the JoySystem at your safehouse, while Bang for Your Buck can be found at arcade locations like the Rusty Anchor. Whether you're hunting zombies, solving puzzles, or shooting bucks, there's plenty to keep you entertained when you're not causing trouble across Leonida.

For more GTA 6 tips, secrets, Easter eggs, and walkthroughs, stay tuned to IGN!

author: IGN YouTube
text:
GTA 6 Made $3.79 Billion on Day One - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
As if anyone expected anything different, GTA 6 now has the biggest launch in entertainment history with a staggering $3.79 billion in sales in its first 24 hours. This includes more than 30 million pre-sale copies sold. And keep in mind, the PC version has yet to drop. Although GTA 6's launch dwarfs even the biggest movie releases, it's not a true 1:1 comparison as the game sells for about $80 a copy ($100 if you buy the ultimate edition), and your average movie ticket is nowhere near that expensive. In related news, prior to the launch of GTA 6, gamers spent 14% less this October than last year, despite heavy hitters like Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 and the Ocarina of Time remake dropping in the same month. This is likely due to the GTA 6 effect, and gamers wanting to save their time and money for that game instead. And finally, Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey film helped boost sales of Ubisoft's Assassin's Creed Odyssey game. AC Odyssey, which was released in 2018, saw a spike in sales after the blockbuster movie debuted in July.

text:
Farsight - Official Release Window Trailer | Horror Game Awards Fall 2026
You know the house from the eye exam? The one in the middle of a grassy field. Farsight is a first-person dreamcore psychological horror game about a twelve-year-old kid taken for a routine eye exam who finds himself in the liminal images of the eye exam machine. Peer through keyholes, watch from a distance with binoculars, and use the FUNTIME-GO camera to see beneath the surface of a place you've somehow always been familiar with. 

Get another look at Farsight in this trailer for the upcoming psychological horror game ahead of its release on Steam in 2027.

text:
Dead by Daylight - Official Terrifier Release Date Trailer | Horror Game Awards Fall 2026
Take a look at the Terrifier Release Date Trailer for Dead by Daylight, the hit asymmetrical horror game developed by Behaviour Interactive. 10 years of horror. 10 years of jump scares and close calls. 10 years of brutal sacrifices and thrilling escapes.​​ Trapped forever in a realm of eldritch evil where even death is not an escape, four determined Survivors face a bloodthirsty Killer in a vicious game of nerve and wits. Pick a side and step into a world of tension and terror with horror gaming's best asymmetrical multiplayer. The Terrifier content for Dead by Daylight is launching on November 24 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
